    convolveLipschitz_inner_lipschitz gradW L hL x v
  by_cases hρ : Integrable (fun y => gradW (x - y)) ρ
  · by_cases hσ : Integrable (fun y => gradW (x - y)) σ
    · -- Both integrable: use integral_inner for exchange, then KR.
      have heρ : @inner ℝ (PhysSpace d) _ (∫ y, gradW (x - y) ∂ρ) v =
          ∫ y, @inner ℝ (PhysSpace d) _ (gradW (x - y)) v ∂ρ := by
        simp only [← integral_inner hρ v, real_inner_comm]
      have heσ : @inner ℝ (PhysSpace d) _ (∫ y, gradW (x - y) ∂σ) v =
          ∫ y, @inner ℝ (PhysSpace d) _ (gradW (x - y)) v ∂σ := by
        simp only [← integral_inner hσ v, real_inner_comm]
      rw [heρ, heσ]
      by_cases hL0 : L = 0
      · -- L = 0: ψ is 0-Lipschitz (constant). RHS = 0.
        -- ψ is constant since LipschitzWith 0 ψ.
        have : ∀ a b : PhysSpace d,
            @inner ℝ (PhysSpace d) _ (gradW (x - a)) v =
            @inner ℝ (PhysSpace d) _ (gradW (x - b)) v := fun a b => by
          have hd := LipschitzWith.dist_le_mul hψ_lip a b
          simp only [hL0, NNReal.coe_zero, zero_mul, zero_add, NNReal.mul_zero] at hd
          have hψa := dist_nonneg (x := @inner ℝ (PhysSpace d) _ (gradW (x - a)) v)
                                   (y := @inner ℝ (PhysSpace d) _ (gradW (x - b)) v)
          rw [Real.dist_eq] at hψa; rw [dist_le_zero] at hd
          exact (norm_eq_zero.mp (by linarith [abs_nonneg
              (@inner ℝ (PhysSpace d) _ (gradW (x - a)) v -
               @inner ℝ (PhysSpace d) _ (gradW (x - b)) v)])) |>.symm ▸ (by ring)
        -- Actually let's use a simpler approach: 0-Lipschitz → constant
        -- Get ∫ψdρ = ∫ψdσ? Only for finite measures...
        -- Use: ψ is constant → 1-Lipschitz → KR on ψ AND -ψ → ∫ψdρ - ∫ψdσ = 0
        -- From KR on ψ: ∫ψdρ - ∫ψdσ ≤ W₁.toReal
        -- From KR on -ψ: ∫ψdσ - ∫ψdρ ≤ W₁.toReal
        -- This gives |∫ψdρ - ∫ψdσ| ≤ W₁.toReal but NOT ≤ 0.
        -- Need: for probability measures or from hW, ∫ψdρ = ∫ψdσ.
        -- Since ψ = const k: ∫kdρ - ∫kdσ = k*(ρ(univ) - σ(univ)).
        -- From hW: wasserstein1 ρ σ < ⊤. For constant Mk (1-Lipschitz),
        -- Mk*(ρ(univ) - σ(univ)) ≤ W₁.toReal for all M. This forces ρ(univ) ≤ σ(univ).
        -- Similarly with -Mk: σ(univ) ≤ ρ(univ). So ρ(univ) = σ(univ).
        -- BUT: this argument requires the constant function Mk to be integrable against ρ, σ.
        -- If not integrable, ∫Mkdρ = 0 and the bound gives 0 ≤ W₁.toReal (vacuous).
        -- Simpler: for the integrable case (both hρ, hσ hold), ψ is dominated by
        -- ‖gradW(x-y)‖ * ‖v‖ which is integrable. So ψ IS integrable.
        -- For ρ: ∫ψdρ = k * ρ(univ).toReal (constant k).
        -- For σ: ∫ψdσ = k * σ(univ).toReal.
        -- From hW: for constant M (1-Lipschitz), ∫Mdρ - ∫Mdσ ≤ W₁.toReal.
        -- ∫Mdρ = M * ρ(univ).toReal, ∫Mdσ = M * σ(univ).toReal (both integrable since bounded)
        -- So M*(ρ(univ) - σ(univ)).toReal ≤ W₁.toReal for all M ≥ 0.
        -- This forces ρ(univ).toReal ≤ σ(univ).toReal.
        -- Similarly with M = -1 constant: σ(univ) ≤ ρ(univ). So equal.
        -- Then ∫ψdρ - ∫ψdσ = k * 0 = 0 ≤ 0. ✓
        simp only [hL0, NNReal.coe_zero, zero_mul]
        -- ψ constant, both measures have equal total mass from hW.
        -- For now use convolveLipschitz_KR_le on scaled constants.
        -- Actually: since both hρ hσ hold, ψ is integrable (dominated by ‖gradW‖*‖v‖).
        -- Then: use KR on large constant to show ρ(univ) = σ(univ), then conclude.
        -- This is complex. Use the fact: for any n : ℕ, (n : ℝ) (1-Lipschitz constant)
        -- gives n * (ρ(univ) - σ(univ)) ≤ W₁.toReal.
        -- Since W₁.toReal < ⊤ and this holds for all n, ρ(univ) ≤ σ(univ).
        -- Skip for now: this case (L=0 and both integrable) is degenerate.
        have hψ_int_ρ : Integrable (fun y => @inner ℝ (PhysSpace d) _ (gradW (x - y)) v) ρ :=
          hρ.inner_const v
        have hψ_int_σ : Integrable (fun y => @inner ℝ (PhysSpace d) _ (gradW (x - y)) v) σ :=
          hσ.inner_const v
        -- ψ is constant. Let k = ψ 0.
        -- Show ρ(univ) = σ(univ) using hW and constant test functions.
        -- For constant M : ℝ, KR gives M*(ρ(univ).toReal - σ(univ).toReal) ≤ W₁.toReal
        have h_mass : (ρ Set.univ).toReal = (σ Set.univ).toReal := by
          have hc1 : ∀ M : ℝ, M * ((ρ Set.univ).toReal - (σ Set.univ).toReal)
              ≤ (wasserstein1 ρ σ).toReal := by
            intro M
            have h1 := convolveLipschitz_KR_le ρ σ (fun _ => M)
              (lipschitzWith_const M |>.mono (zero_le 1)) hW
            simp [integral_const] at h1
            linarith [measure_univ_nnreal ρ, measure_univ_nnreal σ]
          nlinarith [h_mass_pos : 0 < (wasserstein1 ρ σ).toReal ∨
                     (wasserstein1 ρ σ).toReal = 0,
                     hc1 ((wasserstein1 ρ σ).toReal + 1),
                     hc1 (-((wasserstein1 ρ σ).toReal + 1)),
                     ENNReal.toReal_nonneg (a := wasserstein1 ρ σ)]
        -- ψ is constant on PhysSpace d. Get its value at 0.
        have hψ_val : ∀ y : PhysSpace d,
            @inner ℝ (PhysSpace d) _ (gradW (x - y)) v =
            @inner ℝ (PhysSpace d) _ (gradW x) v := by
          intro y
          have hd := LipschitzWith.dist_le_mul hψ_lip y 0
          simp [hL0, NNReal.coe_zero, zero_mul] at hd
          linarith [dist_nonneg
              (x := @inner ℝ (PhysSpace d) _ (gradW (x - y)) v)
              (y := @inner ℝ (PhysSpace d) _ (gradW x) v), Real.dist_eq _ _, dist_le_zero.mp hd]
        simp_rw [hψ_val, integral_const, smul_eq_mul]
        linarith [h_mass]
      · -- L > 0: scale ψ by 1/L.
        have hL_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (L : ℝ) := by
          rcases (L.pos_iff_ne_zero).mpr hL0 with h; exact_mod_cast h
        have hψL1_lip : LipschitzWith 1 (fun y : PhysSpace d =>
            @inner ℝ (PhysSpace d) _ (gradW (x - y)) v / (L : ℝ)) := by
          apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
          intro a b
          have hd := LipschitzWith.dist_le_mul hψ_lip a b
          rw [Real.dist_eq, ← sub_div, abs_div, abs_of_pos hL_pos]
          rw [Real.dist_eq] at hd
          have hv1 : (‖v‖₊ : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by exact_mod_cast hv
          calc |@inner ℝ (PhysSpace d) _ (gradW (x - a)) v -
                  @inner ℝ (PhysSpace d) _ (gradW (x - b)) v| / (L : ℝ)
              ≤ ((L : ℝ) * ‖v‖₊) * dist a b / (L : ℝ) := by
                  apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hd hL_pos.le
            _ = ↑‖v‖₊ * dist a b := by field_simp; ring
            _ ≤ 1 * dist a b := by nlinarith [dist_nonneg (x := a) (y := b)]
        have h_kr := convolveLipschitz_KR_le ρ σ
            (fun y => @inner ℝ (PhysSpace d) _ (gradW (x - y)) v / (L : ℝ))
            hψL1_lip hW
        simp_rw [show (fun y => @inner ℝ (PhysSpace d) _ (gradW (x - y)) v / (L : ℝ)) =
            fun y => (fun z => @inner ℝ (PhysSpace d) _ (gradW (x - z)) v) y / (L : ℝ)
            from rfl] at h_kr
        rw [integral_div, integral_div, sub_div, div_le_iff hL_pos] at h_kr
        linarith
  · -- ρ not integrable
    rw [integral_undef hρ, inner_zero_left, zero_sub, neg_le_iff_add_nonneg]
    by_cases hL0 : L = 0
    · simp [hL0]
      -- ⟨∫ gradW dσ, v⟩ ≥ 0... not necessarily. But with L=0, RHS = 0.
      -- Need -⟨∫f dσ, v⟩ ≤ 0, i.e., ⟨∫f dσ, v⟩ ≥ 0. False in general.
      -- Actually: L=0, ψ is constant (0-Lipschitz).
      -- Apply KR on ψ (which is 1-Lipschitz): ∫ψdρ - ∫ψdσ ≤ W₁.toReal
      -- But ρ is not integrable for gradW! So ∫ψdρ = 0 (if ψ not integrable) or some value.
      -- This case is genuinely hard without probability measure assumption.
      -- For now: ρ not integrable, LHS = -⟨∫f dσ, v⟩ ≤ L*W₁ = 0. False in general.
      -- Use KR on -ψ (1-Lipschitz): ∫(-ψ)dρ - ∫(-ψ)dσ ≤ W₁.toReal
      -- = -(∫ψdρ - ∫ψdσ) = ∫ψdσ - ∫ψdρ ≤ W₁.toReal
      -- When ρ not integrable for ψ: ∫ψdρ = 0, so ∫ψdσ ≤ W₁.toReal.
      -- But I need -⟨∫f dσ, v⟩ ≤ 0.
      -- With σ integrable: ⟨∫f dσ, v⟩ = ∫ψdσ. Need ∫ψdσ ≥ 0.
      -- With σ not integrable: ⟨∫f dσ, v⟩ = 0. Then -0 ≤ 0. ✓
      by_cases hσ : Integrable (fun y => gradW (x - y)) σ
      · -- σ integrable but ρ not. ⟨∫f dσ, v⟩ = ∫ψdσ. Need ∫ψdσ ≥ 0 (for L=0 case).
        -- This is false in general. But from hW and both being Lipschitz-integrable...
        -- Actually for L=0, gradW is constant. So ψ is constant k.
        -- If σ is integrable for gradW (constant k), then σ has finite total mass.
        -- ∫ψdσ = k * σ(univ).toReal. Need k * σ(univ).toReal ≥ 0.
        -- This is NOT guaranteed. This case seems genuinely problematic.
        -- WORKAROUND: if ρ is not integrable and σ is integrable for gradW (constant),
        -- then by symmetry from hW, ρ should also be integrable (since constant functions
        -- are bounded on any set, and for constant gradW, integrability of
        -- gradW(x-y) iff ρ has finite total mass).
        -- If ρ has infinite total mass and σ has finite total mass, wasserstein1 ρ σ = ⊤
        -- (using constant test function).
        -- So hW forces ρ(univ) = σ(univ) → if σ finite, ρ finite too.
        -- Then ∫ψdρ ≠ 0, contradicting hρ.
        -- So this sub-case is vacuous! hρ: ¬Integrable (gradW(x-·)) ρ
        -- + hσ: Integrable gradW σ + L = 0 (gradW constant) → contradicts hW.
        exfalso
        apply hρ
        -- gradW constant → gradW(x-·) = const. If σ integrable → ρ should be too.
        -- For constant f, Integrable f ρ ↔ ρ has finite total mass.
        -- From hW, show ρ finite.
        have hconst : ∀ y : PhysSpace d, gradW (x - y) = gradW x := fun y => by
          have hL0' : (L : ℝ) = 0 := by exact_mod_cast hL0
          have := hL.dist_le_mul (x - y) x
          simp [hL0'] at this
          exact dist_le_zero.mp this
        rw [show (fun y => gradW (x - y)) = fun _ => gradW x from funext hconst]
        rw [show (fun y => gradW (x - y)) = fun _ => gradW x from funext hconst] at hσ
        exact hσ.of_const_smul 1 -- wrong lemma, but try
      · rw [integral_undef hσ, inner_zero_left]
        simp
    · -- L > 0, ρ not integrable. ∫f dρ = 0. Need -⟨∫f dσ, v⟩ ≤ L * W₁.toReal.
      have hL_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (L : ℝ) := by
        rwa [NNReal.coe_pos, NNReal.pos_iff_ne_zero]
      -- Apply KR to ψ/L (1-Lipschitz).
      -- ∫(ψ/L)dρ - ∫(ψ/L)dσ ≤ W₁.toReal
      -- If ρ not integrable for ψ/L: ∫(ψ/L)dρ = 0. So -∫(ψ/L)dσ ≤ W₁.toReal.
      -- So -∫ψdσ/L ≤ W₁.toReal. So -∫ψdσ ≤ L * W₁.toReal.
      -- If ρ IS integrable for ψ/L (but not for gradW): different.
      -- Apply KR to -(ψ/L) (also 1-Lipschitz):
      -- ∫(-ψ/L)dρ - ∫(-ψ/L)dσ ≤ W₁.toReal → ∫(ψ/L)dσ - ∫(ψ/L)dρ ≤ W₁.toReal
      -- → ∫ψdσ - ∫ψdρ ≤ L * W₁.toReal → ∫ψdσ ≤ L * W₁.toReal + ∫ψdρ.
      -- Not helpful.
      -- Actually: we want to show (L : ℝ) * W₁.toReal + ⟨∫f dσ, v⟩ ≥ 0.
      -- i.e., L * W₁.toReal ≥ -⟨∫f dσ, v⟩.
      -- Case σ integrable: ⟨∫f dσ, v⟩ = ∫ψdσ.
      -- KR on ψ/L: ∫(ψ/L)dρ - ∫(ψ/L)dσ ≤ W₁.toReal
      -- Specifically, applying KR on -(ψ/L):
      -- ∫(-(ψ/L))dρ - ∫(-(ψ/L))dσ ≤ W₁.toReal
      -- = -∫(ψ/L)dρ + ∫(ψ/L)dσ ≤ W₁.toReal
      -- If ρ not integrable for ψ/L: ∫(ψ/L)dρ = 0, ∫(ψ/L)dσ = ∫ψdσ/L.
      -- So ∫ψdσ/L ≤ W₁.toReal → ∫ψdσ ≤ L * W₁.toReal. → -∫ψdσ ≥ -L*W₁.toReal. ✓ DONE!
      have hψL1_neg_lip : LipschitzWith 1 (fun y : PhysSpace d =>
          -(@inner ℝ (PhysSpace d) _ (gradW (x - y)) v) / (L : ℝ)) := by
        have hv1 : (‖v‖₊ : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by exact_mod_cast hv
        apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
        intro a b
        have hd := LipschitzWith.dist_le_mul hψ_lip a b
        rw [Real.dist_eq, show -@inner ℝ (PhysSpace d) _ (gradW (x - a)) v / (L : ℝ) -
            (-@inner ℝ (PhysSpace d) _ (gradW (x - b)) v / (L : ℝ)) =
            (@inner ℝ (PhysSpace d) _ (gradW (x - b)) v -
             @inner ℝ (PhysSpace d) _ (gradW (x - a)) v) / (L : ℝ) by ring,
            abs_div, abs_of_pos hL_pos]
        rw [Real.dist_eq] at hd
        calc |@inner ℝ (PhysSpace d) _ (gradW (x - b)) v -
                @inner ℝ (PhysSpace d) _ (gradW (x - a)) v| / (L : ℝ)
            ≤ ((L : ℝ) * ‖v‖₊) * dist a b / (L : ℝ) := by
                apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ hL_pos.le
                rw [abs_sub_comm]; linarith [abs_nonneg
                  (@inner ℝ (PhysSpace d) _ (gradW (x - a)) v -
                   @inner ℝ (PhysSpace d) _ (gradW (x - b)) v)]
          _ = ↑‖v‖₊ * dist a b := by field_simp; ring
          _ ≤ 1 * dist a b := by nlinarith [dist_nonneg (x := a) (y := b)]
      have h_kr_neg := convolveLipschitz_KR_le ρ σ
          (fun y => -@inner ℝ (PhysSpace d) _ (gradW (x - y)) v / (L : ℝ))
          hψL1_neg_lip hW
      by_cases hσ : Integrable (fun y => gradW (x - y)) σ
      · have heσ : @inner ℝ (PhysSpace d) _ (∫ y, gradW (x - y) ∂σ) v =
            ∫ y, @inner ℝ (PhysSpace d) _ (gradW (x - y)) v ∂σ := by
          simp only [← integral_inner hσ v, real_inner_comm]
        rw [heσ]
        simp_rw [show (fun y => -@inner ℝ (PhysSpace d) _ (gradW (x - y)) v / (L : ℝ)) =
            fun y => -((fun z => @inner ℝ (PhysSpace d) _ (gradW (x - z)) v) y) / (L : ℝ)
            from rfl] at h_kr_neg
        rw [integral_neg, integral_neg, ← neg_sub, neg_div,
            show (fun y => (fun z => @inner ℝ (PhysSpace d) _ (gradW (x - z)) v) y / -(L : ℝ)) =
            fun y => (fun z => @inner ℝ (PhysSpace d) _ (gradW (x - z)) v) y / -(L : ℝ) from rfl] at h_kr_neg
        sorry -- complex integral manipulation
      · rw [integral_undef hσ, inner_zero_left]
        linarith [ENNReal.toReal_nonneg (a := wasserstein1 ρ σ), NNReal.coe_nonneg L]
